title: evals/reviewer/<id>.yaml: one reviewer eval case (review_pipeline.reviewer_eval; replaces golden-task, retired 2026-10-27; origin, forbidden_findings and the CI summary block added 2026-10-27, decisions.accepted RVEVALRUN; optional case fields, per-range slack and summary wrong_place added 2026-11-01, decisions.accepted EVALBUNDLE)
description: The reviewer eval set is the only eval agentive keeps in a user project. On a PR that changes a reviewer prompt, model, tool or review rule, the reviewer-eval CI job runs the whole set N times before and after and posts the result to the PR ($defs.summary); the comment is posted whatever the result; the human merges (tier 2) when it improves (adopt_suggested true, no newly_missed) or, when it does not, only with the PR-body line eval-override: <reason> (decisions.accepted EVALOVERRIDE, 2026-10-27; the line is not a schema field; not on the first install, where the base has no reviewer to compare with: reason no_baseline, NOBASELINE 2026-10-31); there is no daily or scheduled run (a user decision that differs from S89, which runs the set daily). Pass rule (review_pipeline.reviewer_eval.scoring): a positive case passes when every expected range is caught by a posted important finding on that file whose line (or an instances line) lies in [line_from - slack, line_to + slack], slack = the range's own slack, else 2 (summary-only mentions do not count); a negative case passes with no blocking finding and no counted finding inside a forbidden_findings range. The bug location of a positive case is human-confirmed: the human merge of the tier 2 PR that adds the case. Retired field: fix_pr (2026-10-27; use origin {kind: fix_pr, ref}). EVALBUNDLE (2026-11-01): the optional fields base_sha, head_sha, bug_class, note, source, created, drafted_by and the per-range slack are backward compatible (no required list changed); a negative case's forbidden range has slack 0; the summary may carry wrong_place, a diagnostic that never enters pass, newly_* or adopt_suggested.

id.description: case id, equal to the file name without .yaml

pr.description: the PR the reviewer is run on: PR number (#N) or base..head sha range. Positive: the PR that caused the incident. Negative: a known-clean PR or a safe counterexample

label.description: positive = a PR that caused an incident or let a bug through, with the ground-truth bug location confirmed by a human; negative = a known-clean PR, a safe counterexample, or a PR whose findings were answered wrong or intentional (forbidden_findings); expected result: no blocking finding

expected_findings.description: positive only: the ground-truth bug location(s), file and an allowed line range, confirmed by a human who knows the code; every range must be caught

slack.description: optional: lines of tolerance around this expected range (line_from - slack .. line_to + slack); default 2; 0 = strict. Forbidden ranges have no slack (always 0)

budget_usd.description: optional --max-budget-usd for the headless run of this case

origin.description: positive only: where the ground-truth location comes from (user decision 2026-10-27, A12). injected_bug is allowed only with the human check that every positive gets (the tier 2 merge)

ref.description: the fix or revert PR (#N) or commit, the path of the reproduction diff, or the commit that injected the bug

forbidden_findings.description: negative only: ranges where a counted finding must not appear (findings answered wrong or intentional before, B11); a negative without it is a clean PR

items.x-source: answered wrong or intentional in an agentive-reply line or an [inferred] reason

base_sha.description: optional, with head_sha: the base commit the case was drafted on; the runner uses base_sha..head_sha instead of asking the PR again, so the line numbers stay valid after a force-push or squash merge

head_sha.description: optional, with base_sha: the head commit the line numbers refer to (a negative case: the head of the round on which the finding was posted)

bug_class.description: optional: the review-report finding bug_class of the bug (same closed enum); used only by the wrong-place diagnostic: when present, a finding on the right file counts as wrong place only with an equal bug_class

note.description: optional: one human-readable line about the bug or the noise; never scored

source.description: optional: where a drafted case came from (traceability; never scored)

reply.description: negative: the reason of the agentive-reply line

range_basis.description: proposed = drafted by /distill from a fix diff or a given location; confirmed = a human checked or corrected the range (the tier 2 merge is the check; the value is for readers)

created.description: optional: date the case was written (YYYY-MM-DD)

drafted_by.description: optional: who wrote the case file

side_counts.description: positives: caught cases; negatives: unwanted findings (lower is better). Means over the N runs; baseline_spread = max - min over the baseline's N runs (run-to-run noise)

case_result.description: a case passes on a side when it passes in a majority of that side's N runs

summary.description: the ```yaml agentive-reviewer-eval``` block of the reviewer-eval CI comment (review_pipeline.reviewer_eval.ci); written by CI, read by the human who merges

baseline_ref.description: base branch commit of the reviewer config (before)

newly_missed.description: positives the baseline caught and the candidate missed: any -> not adopted

newly_noisy.description: negatives that pass on the baseline and fail on the candidate

reason.description: improved = the first differing compare key beats the baseline spread; no_regression = no newly_missed and no newly_noisy; not_run = the reviewer could not run because the job had no repository secret (a fork PR, or a repository without the credential secret: see not_run_cause, E2E-42); no_baseline = the base has no agentive reviewer (no .agents/bin/agentive-review: the first install), so no run is made and nothing is compared; adopt_suggested is true and no eval-override line is needed (decisions.accepted NOBASELINE, E2E-16, 2026-10-31)

wrong_place.description: optional diagnostic (EVALBUNDLE, never part of pass, newly_missed or adopt_suggested): positive cases where some run missed the expected range but posted a counted finding on the same file at another line (bug_class equal when the case has one); the runs out of n_runs per side. The code cannot tell the same bug on the wrong line from another problem, so a human reads it

not_run_cause.description: only with reason not_run (E2E-42): fork = the PR comes from a fork (GitHub gives fork runs no repository secrets); no_secret = a same-repository PR whose repository has no CI credential secret (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY for codex). Absent: the cause is not known
